assumptions: Centered flat NOTE only; fixed-offset +/-5mm geometry counterexamples are preserved, no lateral recentering modeled.
Robot approach/deceleration is prescribed external motion, not a drivetrain plant; contact work from translating base is accounted separately.
NOTE begins at rest in world on ground, not teleported into capture. Two pinch motors reverse mechanical feed direction relative to the elevated handoff.
Belt10N per side,mu.6,groundmu.4 and rotor inertia are hypotheses; sampled rigid overlap is a normalized contact schedule, not solved compression.
Brake damping.002Nm/(rad/s) is an ideal dissipative hypothesis, not a selected motor controller brake specification.
Ground friction is regularized Coulomb force, not measured carpet/NOTE friction or exact static friction.
Ground dwell window178..198mm/20mm/s/100ms is an operational diagnostic, not a FIRST scoring or retention requirement.
No lift/pitch retention, free lateral/yaw dynamics, actual sensor/controller calibration, impact or full-robot acceptance.
Domain exit stops evidence; continued momentum is not automatically unsafe or a demand for retention hardware.
